item.title: Quitting Corporate Life To Sail Crewed Charter In The BVIs
item.description: Be the first to charter Luna , our new 45ft Lagoon 450S, which arrives in the British Virgin Islands in March 2019. Luna’s captain and hostess, Nim and Fabiola, are experts in the BVI’s uncrowded beaches, quiet anchorages and premium dive locations. They take delivery of Luna in the fall and will be ready for March 2019. Luna sleeps six guests in three full-sized queen cabins and you can book now for 10% off March and April 2019 bookings . We chatted to them about their connection with the Caribbean, sailing epiphanies and why it’s all about the detail… From diving to skipper qualifications Nim is a United States Coast Guard certified captain and an experienced PADI divemaster. He worked in the IT industry before sailing full time. He’s been on boats since a young boy and is passionate about life at sea, sailing extensively in Europe and the Caribbean, including the BVIs. He’s experienced in open water and has crossed the Mediterranean, Aegean, Adriatic and Andaman Sea, as well as sailing transatlantic from Europe to the US. He has endless stories and is naturally hospitable and welcoming. Nim said: “I grew up next to the sea and was always on boats as a child. I traveled to Thailand as a young man, got my diving certificates and worked for a year as a divemaster sailing the Similan Islands. “One afternoon I was resting on deck, enjoying the atmosphere and magic of nature when a beautiful yacht appeared with a couple on board. I had an epiphany and realised that sailing my own yacht is what I wanted to do. When I returned home I got a job in the IT industry to fund my sailing passion and resumed my highly demanding offshore skipper certification.” When your heart tells you to sail “In 2005, I got my own boat and I keenly remember the maiden voyage and the feeling of untying the lines and sailing by myself to Greece and Turkey. Of course, I had sailed many times on a charter with friends and was also a member of a sailing club, but this was the first time on my own boat. I sailed in the Mediterranean often, down to the Suez Canal and into the Red Sea. “The time came when I realized I had to do what I love, which was sailing and diving. We only live once, so I quit 25 years in the IT industry and went sailing. Two years ago, I picked up a boat in Europe, sailed across the Mediterranean and the Atlantic to St. Lucia to find adventure. “I continued to Puerto Rico where I met my wife and Luna’s hostess, Fabiola, and we sailed together to Turks and Caicos Islands and the Bahamas. We spent seven months sailing the Caribbean, including two months in the BVIs, USVIs and Spanish VIs. We have been doing crewed charters for a while on our sailing yacht and we enjoy it very much. We love hosting, entertaining, traveling and sailing so why not do this full time? We decided to buy a newer and bigger luxury yacht and we named her Luna.” An authentic connection to the BVIs Fabiola was raised among a family of serious cooks in the Caribbean and she began cooking from the age of eight when she was given her first recipe book. She loves to combine fresh, local produce with international cuisine she has experienced while traveling the world. Her catering experience includes exclusive parties and corporate events. Fluent in English and Spanish and even some French, she grew up on sailboats and holds a Master Captain license from the United States Coast Guard. Creating the perfect atmosphere on board is something she excels at. Fabiola said: “My dad and uncles had sailboats and I sailed with them around the Caribbean from the age of four. At weekends and in the summer, we’d head to BVIs, St. Thomas and St. John. As an adult, I would sail over to BVIs with friends, it is a very popular vacation destination for boaters and a personal favorite. “My family has a strong connection to the BVIs and we’ve supported and watched the islanders work hard to bring tourism back this year. item.title: The Bali 5.4 – perfect for crewed & cabin charters
item.description: With an impressive 54-foot length and 6 guest cabins, the Bali 5.4 makes an ideal charter vacation platform. Whether you choose a private fully crewed charter, or a social cabin charter, you’ll enjoy the comfort and efficient layout of this premium catamaran, while being looked after by your crew. Catamarans are popular for their generous liveable space and Bali has designed a beautiful and functional layout that optimizes space and comfort whether lounging and dining with a group or taking some quiet time in your private en suite cabin. It boasts an impressive 130 sq m of living space, so you’ll never feel cramped. Living areas for relaxing in comfort If you’re looking for a yacht that maximizes outdoor spaces while providing plenty of inviting and cozy interior areas, then the Bali 5.4 is for you. The pivoting rear door opens the entire back wall of the yacht to the outdoors, inviting natural light and sea breezes into the spacious salon. The salon is the central onboard gathering place where you can enjoy al fresco meals in the company of friends at the large dining table. To the front of the yacht, a door from the salon allows direct access to the massive front deck where you’ll find padded sunbeds, cushioned seating and a table. To the rear, the large transom deck provides a long bench seating area as well as steps on either side leading to the water for enjoying a swim or water sports. Your elevated chill lounge There are plenty of other outdoor spaces to enjoy aboard the Bali 5.4. Change your view onboard the Bali 5.4 with the spacious flybridge, accessible via a stairway on each side. The massive U-shaped cushioned seating area that surrounds the 2 dining tables is perfect for taking in the panoramic views while underway or enjoying an evening cocktail at anchor. A large sunbed to the rear of the seating area can easily accommodate a group of 3 to 4 guests for sunbathing and lounging. Whichever living space you choose, you’ll always have a place to relax and enjoy the view in comfort. Aboard the Bali 5.4, you will easily be able to spend a week or more while never feeling crowded. The clever layout, ample storage, multiple lounge areas, and attention to detail is perfectly designed for an unmatched sailing holiday. Take the tour Bali 5.4 cabins Our Bali 5.4 yachts each offer 6 guest cabins and can sleep up to 12 guests with queen-sized beds and plenty of storage space. Each guest cabin also features a private bathroom with shower, wash basin and toilet. Each comfortable cabin is equipped with air conditioning and windows for natural lighting. Some cabins feature a door with direct access to the deck. Our Bali 5.4 charter destinations The Bali 5.4 is available for crewed and cabin cruises, as well as bareboat and skippered charters, in many destinations throughout the world including the Mediterranean, Caribbean , Bahamas and Tahiti . About our charters Our fully crewed and cabin cruise staff are ready to make your dreams a reality with a sailing vacation that you’ll remember for years to come.
